newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: STIC buys food company for S$69.82 mln.
newsitem.headline: STIC buys food company for S$69.82 mln.

text.p: Singapore Technologies Industrial Corp Ltd (STIC) said on Thursday it had agreed to buy the remaining 49.9 percent equity of Singapore Food Industries Pte Ltd for Singapore $69.82 million.
A company statement said STIC, which already owns 50.1 percent of Singapore Food, will pay for the acquisition in cash.
The sellers are the Singapore government's investment units Temasek Holdings Pte Ltd and Singapore Technologies Pte Ltd.
STIC said the rationale for the acquisition was to expand its operations in the food industry.
Singapore Food is a major food processing company and recently was in a joint venture to set up a US$150 million project for a commercial pig farm and related activities in China.
The food business contributed pretax profit of S$15.12 million to STIC in 1995.
